summary: Join-session error enum translator. Reads the sub-object pointer at this+0x0, then the argument at obj+0x3FB8, and calls SingleDelegationCall_a900 as a gate: if it returns non-zero (delegation active) the function returns 0. Otherwise sub_57A590 converts the input enum a2 into an intermediate value v2, which is then mapped 0->0, 2->1, 3->2, 5->4, with every other value (including 1 and 4) mapped to 3. Callers recorded in existing analysis: AutoJoinRetryLoop and MultiplayerSessionJoinHandler.

operations.description: Read sub-object pointer at this+0x0 and read the argument at obj+0x3FB8, then call SingleDelegationCall_a900; a non-zero result (delegation active) blocks and returns 0

v2 == 0 returns 0 (unknown or invalid intermediate value)
Compute v3 = v2 - 2 and v4 = v3 - 1 to discriminate intermediate values 2, 3 and 5
Default mapping returns 3, which also covers intermediate values 1 and 4
